name: kimi
description: Kimi (Moonshot AI) runner via the Moonshot Chat Completions API

backend.description: Backend: api (Moonshot Chat Completions, runs the tool loop — the only backend this build ships) or cli (Kimi Code CLI — not implemented in this iteration; the installed CLI lacks the required flags and needs Node >= 22)

model.description: Default model (selection via models registry, not restricted by enum)

base_url.description: Moonshot serves api.moonshot.ai and api.moonshot.cn to different audiences

timeout.description: Ceiling on a single turn, in seconds

max_retries.description: Retries after the first attempt (2 = three attempts total)

max_output_tokens.description: max_tokens sent on every Chat Completions request

max_tool_iterations.description: Bound on the tool-call loop per turn, before it is interrupted

cli_meta.token_hint: Get your API key from Moonshot Console
